name: Decoupled Toolbox for Redirect
description: Creates Computed field for url redirects and makes it compatible with Decoupled Toolbox.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox for Redirect is a sub-module of Decoupled Toolbox. It adds a computed base field `redirect_source__path` (via hook_entity_base_field_info) to every entity type that has a canonical link template; the field lists the source paths of the contrib Redirect module's redirects that point at the entity, so those aliases can be placed on the Decoupled view mode and exposed in the JSON output. Requires the contrib Redirect module.
